details.publicNotes:
The first metallic phase elementals were the result of an eccentric alchemist's tireless research into the boundaries between the classical states of matter: solid, liquid, and gas. These elementals can change their forms between these states effortlessly, and they use their different forms to adapt to whatever challenges come their way. The temperament of a metallic phase elemental is closely connected with their preferred form, with stubborn ones preferring their solid state, while wilder ones favor their gaseous state.

Most metallic phase elementals maintain a collection of different types of metals. Nobles and educational institutions have been known to pay them in rare elements to convince them to perform demonstrations or even give guest lectures on alchemical principles.

A metallic phase elemental that collects enough of a valuable metal, such as cold iron or silver, can infuse it through their body. This infusion allows the elemental to bypass resistances overcome by their chosen metal and grants them the elite adjustments. Though cold iron and silver infusions are the most common, infusions of rarer metals are rumored to exist, granting the elemental still greater advantages.

What's Mine is Mine

Metallic phase elementals can be just as avaricious hoarders of coins as any dragon or adventurer—the problem begins when the coins in question belong to someone else. While metallic phase elementals have a sophisticated understanding of the concept of "my property," efforts to explain "someone else's property" to them have so far been unsuccessful. A metallic phase elemental might burrow through the wall of a palace treasury and claim the wealth therein, reacting with surprised indignation when the palace's inhabitants try to reclaim their treasure.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 30/65/125 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (bludgeoning, piercing, slashing), armor (light, medium, heavy), perception item, skill items (Acrobatics, Athletics, Crafting)

Eligible Imbued Properties body, bane, constitution, dexterity, elongating, energy resistant (vitality), intelligence, metal, sensory (darkvision), strength, throwing, wild

description.value:
A metallic phase elemental begins the encounter in one of the following forms.

Gas Form The elemental is a shimmering cloud of gas. When this form, they can use their shard blast Strike, Phase Change, and Storm of Metal. They also gain a 30-foot fly speed.

Liquid Form The elemental is a metallic goop. When in this form, they can use their liquid lash Strike, Phase Change, and Wild Splash. They also gain a 40-foot swim speed.

Solid Form The elemental is a solid block of metal. When in this form, they can use their metal fist Strike and Phase Change. They also gain a 30-foot burrow speed and tremorsense (imprecise) 30 feet.
The metallic phase elemental's molecular structure shifts and vibrates, changing from one of their Phases of Matter to another.

Requirements The metallic phase elemental is in their gas form

Effect The metallic phase elemental turns into a tornado of metal shards that tear apart all in their path. The metallic phase elemental Flies, passing through the spaces of creatures in their path. Creatures whose spaces the elemental enters during this movement take @Damage[4d6[slashing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save). Creatures that critically fail also take @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Requirements The metallic phase elemental is in their liquid form

Effect The metallic phase elemental makes three liquid lash Strikes at a –2 penalty, each against a different target. These attacks count toward the metallic phase elemental's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after they make all their attacks.
